query:
SELECT team_id, user_id FROM rb_team_member
        WHERE team_id = (
            SELECT tm.team_id FROM rb_team_member tm
            JOIN rb_team t ON t.id = tm.team_id
            WHERE t.game_id = $1 AND t.tstate = 0
                AND tm.user_id = $2 AND tm.is_captain
        ) FOR UPDATE;
